items.title: Kenny Barron — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I have lots of interesting stuff. Some pop stuff, like, I love Anita Baker. I love James Brown. That’s on there, probably right next to John Coltrane. It’s all good music.

ctx.x: That was incredible. I don’t think I’d even gotten married yet. I had just come to New York. That was one of the first gigs: Moody, and then Roy Haynes. With Moody, it was a sextet, and we were doing a lot of music by Tom McIntosh. He had a really great band. It was Tom McIntosh; Steve Davis, who was Trane’s bass player; Dave Burns, playing trumpet; Edgar Bateman was the drummer. It was great. Then, with – who? My mind is leaving me. The other band we just mentioned.
You said Moody and then Dizzy, and then what was – yeah, that’s a good question. Kimery: Roy.
